text:
Lina Torres: Noticed a spike in onboarding issues this morning. New users on Bun and Deno report failed imports after our last package.json exports tweak. Error examples: "Uncaught SyntaxError: The requested module '"@redwood/inference"' does not provide an export named 'default'" and "Could not resolve module '@redwood/inference'" in Deno Deploy.

Mark Y: Repro'd with bun run and deno bundle. Both runtimes use different resolution heuristics for conditional exports and wildcard subpaths. Our current exports only declare the package root (import/require) and a ./package.json entry. Bun seems to prefer a module field or a wildcard like "./*" to resolve internal imports used by some bundlers.

Sam: Also getting complaints from TypeScript users — IDEs cannot find types unless they deep-import dist. We removed top-level types in the cleanup which made the package ambiguous for non-NodeJS resolvers.

Lina Torres: Minimal reproduction in sample-apps/onboarding-bun: import { createClient } from '@redwood/inference'
-> bun dev fails at startup. Adding an alias to node_modules/dist/esm works but we shouldn't require that.

Mark Y: Quick proposal: publish a patch with: top-level "types": "dist/index.d.ts", keep "main" and "module" fields, and expand exports to include a wildcard fallback and explicit helpers: 
"exports": {".":{...}, "./*": {"import":"./dist/esm/*.mjs","require":"./dist/cjs/*.cjs"}, "./package.json":"./package.json"} — wildcard resolution isn't universally supported but helps Bun/Esbuild style bundlers. Also add explicit "./auth" and "./retry" subpaths for code that imports internals.

Sam: For the ESM bundle we accidentally excluded auth/retry (rollup external). Quick fix: re-bundle ensuring auth is part of esm entry; alternativly emit separate esm artifacts for helpers and wire exports to them. Also add a typesVersions map for TS consumers who target different module systems.

ci-bot: CI #834 sample-apps/onboarding-bun FAILED. Snippet: "Error: Could not resolve '@redwood/inference' during bun dev". Full log: https://ci.internal/834 (internal)

Lina Torres: Action items:
- Mark: open a patch PR to add types, main/module fallback, explicit ./auth & ./retry exports, and a conservative wildcard export (target v0.14.4).
- Sam: update rollup to include auth/retry in esm output OR add dedicated helper artifacts and d.ts. Add typesVersions mapping.
- Me: add a short note in onboarding guide listing Bun/Deno caveats and a temporary alias snippet for quickstarts.

Mark Y: I'll also add a fast CI smoke job running bun and deno bundle against the quickstarts to catch regressions. Will ping here with PR link.
